title: 第二章 金童玉女婚变，《白夜追凶》筹备
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

接下来两天，苏行舟一边筹备接下来的事项，一边派人前往海口办事。

这期间他还抓住每一分时间，学习着制作人相关专业知识。

他像一块海绵吸取着知识，找了不少好莱坞和南棒的资料来看。

苏行舟作为北电大一导演系学生，本来就不陌生这些内容，学起来还是很快的。

他知道这不是一个照本宣科的职业，资料看再多也难以大成。

制作人是需要磨练，积累经验，逐步成长的。

与各方的对接洽谈，对整个项目的协调调度是重中之重。

当然，核心还是要制片人的地位够高。

只有所有人足够重视你这位制作人，诸多操作才能施展，苏行舟要和自己的p站共同成长。

“苏总，银行那边流程审批已经通过，这几天就会抵押放款。”

钟大强把手头几件重要的事情进度汇报给他。

“好~辛苦钟叔。”

苏行舟不意外这个速度。

他名下有正规企业，网站流水，是银行优质授信客户，走企业经营性房产抵押绿色通道不用一周就能放款，额度还更高。

“海口那边派去的人拍到了！”

钟大强平常表情不多，情绪波动不大，但在掏出照片的时候也有点难绷。

一张张刺激的照片被摆在苏行舟桌上，要是流出去能瞬间引爆网络。

“嚯，美女与野兽啊！”

苏行舟看到了熟悉的接吻照片，一点也不意外，但还是再发出感慨。

他知道董婕两人会在王大志生日当天出现在酒店楼下激吻。

先射箭再画靶，他派出去的狗仔轻松拍到这一幕。

“啧，没想到居然是她出轨，可为什么会是王大志？”

钟大强也关心最近的娱乐新闻，他也被董婕骗了，以为这是一个好女人被辜负的事情。

谁知道这是个烂裤裆。

但是钟大强最难以理解的是董婕的出轨对象怎么会是个癞蛤蟆？

字面上的癞蛤蟆。

小眼睛塌鼻梁，厚嘴唇牙缝大个子矮，王大志被誉为娱乐圈最丑男星。

这些忘我的接吻照片，无论看几次都难以评价。

董婕怎么下得了嘴的？

要知道，她老公可是誉为古装美男的潘岳明啊。

难道有恋丑癖？

“正因为她结婚了，因为她老公很优秀，才导致她会做出这样的选择。”苏行舟笑着把照片收好，起身准备办事：“卓伟那边拍到没有？”

“按你的吩咐，提前安排好了四五人捣乱，人都被赶跑了，他们不可能拍得到。”

钟大强汇报完事项，连忙追问苏行舟为什么会说出这样的原因，他很好奇。

“从小家境优越，容貌出众，到哪都被追捧的女性，在结婚之后心态会有微妙变化。结婚前高傲得不行，王大志是绝对不可能有机会拿下董婕的。

但是结婚后，之前排着队的舔狗全都消失不见，女神们心里是会有落差的。

在她们眼里，甚至会觉得婚后还能坚持追求自己的人才是真爱。

潘岳明和她同样优秀，高颜值，有才华。结婚前的恋爱是对他才华条件的认可，可婚后的相处都是柴米油盐的平静日子。

潘岳明不会以下位姿态对董婕嘘寒问暖，而王大志舔起来没下限，她会动摇再正常不过了。”

说完，苏行舟不墨迹，整理下衣着就出门了。

只要确保这个料只有他有，卓威没有，价值就能最大化。

钟大强站在原地消化他说的这些东西，看着苏行舟的离去的背影，感觉这孩子和以前比不同了。

..........

朝阳区东三环的高档公寓。

“这些无良媒体！”

In the next two days, Su Xingzhou sent people to Haikou to handle matters while preparing for the next matters.

During this period, he also seized every moment to learn relevant professional knowledge as a producer.

He absorbed knowledge like a sponge and read a lot of information about Hollywood and South Korea.

As a first-year directing student at Nortel, Su Xingzhou was no stranger to these contents, and he learned it quickly.

He knew that this was not a scripted profession, and no matter how much information he read, it would be difficult to achieve success.

Producers need to hone, accumulate experience, and gradually grow.

Negotiations with all parties and coordination of the entire project are the top priority.

Of course, the core still requires the producer’s status to be high enough.

Only when everyone pays enough attention to you as a producer can many operations be performed. Su Xingzhou must grow together with his p station.

"Mr. Su, the bank's approval process has been passed, and the mortgage loan will be issued in the next few days."

Zhong Daqiang reported to him the progress of several important things at hand.

"Okay~ Thank you for your hard work, Uncle Zhong."

Su Xingzhou was not surprised by this speed.

He has a formal enterprise under his name, has a successful website, and is a high-quality credit customer of the bank. He can get a loan in less than a week by taking the green channel for commercial real estate mortgage, and the amount is even higher.

"The people sent from Haikou took the picture!"

Zhong Daqiang usually doesn't express much and doesn't have big mood swings, but he was a little nervous when he took out the photos.

A series of exciting photos were placed on Su Xingzhou's desk. If they were leaked, they would instantly detonate the Internet.

"Oh, Beauty and the Beast!"

Su Xingzhou was not surprised at all when he saw the familiar kissing photo, but he still sighed again.

He knew that Dong Jie and Dong Jie would appear downstairs in the hotel and kiss passionately on Wang Dazhi's birthday.

Shooting arrows first and then drawing targets, the paparazzi he sent out easily captured this scene.

"Tsk, I didn't expect that she would be the one cheating on her, but why would it be Wang Dazhi?"

Zhong Daqiang is also concerned about the recent entertainment news. He was also deceived by Dong Jie, thinking that this was a matter of a good woman being let down.

Who knew it was a bad crotch.

But the most difficult thing for Zhong Daqiang to understand is how could Dong Jie's cheating partner be a toad?

Literally a toad.

With small eyes, a flat nose, thick lips and gap between teeth, he is tall and short. Wang Dazhi is known as the ugliest male star in the entertainment industry.

These selfless kissing photos are hard to evaluate no matter how many times you see them.

How could Dong Jie be so talkative?

You know, her husband is Pan Yueming, who is known as a handsome man in ancient costume.

Do you have a fetish for ugliness?

"It is precisely because she is married and because her husband is very good that she made such a choice." Su Xingzhou smiled and put the photo away, got up and got ready to do something: "Did Zhuo Wei take the photo?"

"According to your instructions, four or five people were arranged in advance to cause trouble. Everyone was driven away. It was impossible for them to take pictures."

After Zhong Daqiang reported the matter, he quickly asked Su Xingzhou why he said such a reason. He was very curious.

"Women who grew up with superior family backgrounds, outstanding looks, and are sought after everywhere will have subtle changes in their mentality after getting married. Wang Dazhi was extremely arrogant before getting married. There is absolutely no chance that Wang Dazhi will have the chance to win over Dong Jie.

But after getting married, all the licking dogs that were lined up before disappear, and the goddesses will feel a gap in their hearts.

In their eyes, they even think that only those who persist in pursuing themselves after marriage are true love.

Pan Yueming is as good as her, good-looking and talented.The love before marriage was a recognition of his talent and qualifications, but the relationship after marriage was a peaceful life of daily necessities.

Pan Yueming would not greet Dong Jie in a humble manner, but Wang Dazhi's licking had no limit, so it was normal for her to be shaken."

After saying that, Su Xingzhou straightened his clothes and went out.

As long as he ensures that only he has this material and Zhuo Wei does not, the value can be maximized.

Zhong Daqiang stood there digesting what he said. Looking at Su Xingzhou's leaving back, he felt that this child was different from before.

...........

A high-end apartment in East Third Ring Road, Chaoyang District.

"These unscrupulous media!"
